name: Drink
overview: Scripture warns of the dangers associated with strong drink and intoxicating beverages, highlighting how they can deceive and mislead the wise (Proverbs 20:1) and cause error even among spiritual leaders (Isaiah 28:7). While drinking with a joyful heart is not condemned (Ecclesiastes 9:7), persistent indulgence from morning until night and excessive strength in drinking bring woe and spiritual ruin (Isaiah 5:11, 5:22). Believers are called to live honorably, avoiding drunkenness and its accompanying behaviors (Romans 13:13), recognizing that intoxication leads to impaired judgment and a departure from God's ways.
